target.title: fix(agents): respect provider default thinking level over global thinkingDefault
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Cron agentTurn jobs using Ollama models produce empty responses when `agents.defaults.thinkingDefault` is configured, because the global default unconditionally overrides the provider's own default of `"off"`.

- **Problem**: `resolveThinkingDefault()` checks `agents.defaults.thinkingDefault` before the provider-specific default, so when a user has `thinkingDefault: "low"` (common for Claude), Ollama receives a non-`"off"` thinking level → `think: true` in the Ollama API → model consumes 100% of output tokens on reasoning → empty `content` → "Agent couldn't generate a response"
- **Solution**: Resolve the provider-specific default first, then only apply the global `thinkingDefault` when the provider does not explicitly default to `"off"`
- **What changed**: `src/agents/model-thinking-default.ts` (reorder evaluation in `resolveThinkingDefault()`), new test file `src/agents/model-thinking-default.test.ts`
- **What did NOT change**: Per-model `params.thinking` priority, Claude hardcoded special cases, the Ollama provider plugin, or any behavior for providers without an explicit default

## Change Type (select all)

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor required for the fix
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Chore/infra

## Scope (select all)

- [ ] Gateway / orchestration
- [x] Skills / tool execution
- [ ] Auth / tokens
- [ ] Memory / storage
- [ ] Integrations
- [ ] API / contracts
- [ ] UI / DX
- [ ] CI/CD / infra

## Linked Issue/PR

- Fixes #104212

- [x] This PR fixes a bug or regression

## Motivation

When `agents.defaults.thinkingDefault` is set to enable thinking for the primary model (usually Claude), the global default unconditionally overrides every provider's own default thinking level. For Ollama, which explicitly defaults to `"off"` in `extensions/ollama/provider-policy-api.ts`, this forces `think: true` in the Ollama API request, causing models like Qwen3.5-4B to consume all output tokens on reasoning and produce zero visible content.

The same Ollama workflow works correctly when no global `thinkingDefault` is set, or when `params.thinking` is explicitly configured per model.

## Evidence

- Behavior addressed: Global `agents.defaults.thinkingDefault` must not override provider-specific defaults that are `"off"`
- Real environment tested: Ubuntu Linux, Node 22, branch `fix/ollama-respect-default-thinking-104212`
- Exact steps or command run after this patch:

```
pnpm tsgo:core      # type check
npx oxfmt --check src/agents/model-thinking-default.ts src/agents/model-thinking-default.test.ts  # format check
npx oxlint --deny-warnings src/agents/model-thinking-default.ts src/agents/model-thinking-default.test.ts  # lint check
pnpm test src/agents/model-thinking-default.test.ts --run  # unit tests
pnpm check:import-cycles  # cycle check
```

- Evidence after fix (real runtime invocation via `resolveThinkingDefault()`):

```console
$ node --import tsx -e "import { resolveThinkingDefault } from './src/agents/model-thinking-default.js'; ..."

Real Behavior Evidence — PR #104248 / Fixes #104212
Environment: Node v22.19.0, linux
========================================
PASS | Ollama + global thinkingDefault=low                     result=off (expected off)
PASS | Ollama + global thinkingDefault=adaptive                result=off (expected off)
PASS | Ollama + global thinkingDefault=off                     result=off (expected off)
PASS | No global default                                       result=off (expected off)
PASS | Claude Sonnet 4.6 + global=adaptive                     result=adaptive (expected adaptive)
PASS | Claude Sonnet 4.6 + global=low                          result=low (expected low)
PASS | Claude Opus 4.7 + global=adaptive                       result=off (expected off)
PASS | Claude Opus 4.8 + global=adaptive                       result=off (expected off)
PASS | Ollama + per-model params=low + global=adaptive         result=low (expected low)
PASS | Ollama + per-model params=off + global=low              result=off (expected off)
========================================
10 passed, 0 failed
```

- Observed result after fix:
  1. Ollama + global `thinkingDefault: "low"` → `"off"` (provider default wins)
  2. Ollama + global `thinkingDefault: "adaptive"` → `"off"` (provider default wins)
  3. Ollama + per-model `params.thinking: "low"` → `"low"` (per-model override works)
  4. Ollama + per-model `params.thinking: "off"` → `"off"` (per-model override works)
  5. Unknown provider + global `thinkingDefault: "low"` → `"low"` (no provider default, global applies)
  6. Claude Opus 4.7 + global `thinkingDefault: "adaptive"` → `"off"` (hardcoded special case preserved)
  7. No global default → returns provider default

- What was not tested: Real Ollama end-to-end with actual model inference (requires local Ollama instance with a thinking-capable model). The fix is in a pure function whose behavior is fully covered by real runtime invocation with 10/10 scenarios passing.
- **Fix completeness pre-check (4 questions)**
  - ✅ Auth guard: No policy/permission change
  - ✅ Enum completeness: All thinking levels (`off`/`low`/`medium`/`high`/`adaptive`/etc.) handled by existing checks; the fix only reorders them
  - ✅ Path coverage: Single change in shared `resolveThinkingDefault()` covers cron, embedded runner (session), and subagent paths
  - ✅ Cleanup symmetry: No new state to clean up

## Root Cause

In `src/agents/model-thinking-default.ts`, `resolveThinkingDefault()` checked `agents.defaults.thinkingDefault` (lines 71-73) **before** `resolveThinkingDefaultForModel()` (lines 101-106), so the global config default unconditionally overrode the provider-specific default from plugin policy or catalog metadata.

Introduced by: Peter Steinberger (`steipete`) in commit `d5eec80e340` — the initial implementation of `resolveThinkingDefault()`.

## Regression Test Plan

All 9 new unit tests pass on every run. Existing `thinking-runtime.test.ts` (8 tests) continues to pass — no behavioral change for Claude models or unconfigured providers.

## User-visible / Behavior Changes

Ollama users who have `agents.defaults.thinkingDefault` set will no longer see forced thinking mode in cron agentTurn jobs. The Ollama model will run with its default behavior (thinking off) unless explicitly configured per-model via `agents.defaults.models[].params.thinking`.

## Security Impact (required)

- [x] New permissions/capabilities? No
- [x] Secrets/tokens handling changed? No
- [x] New/changed network calls? No
- [x] Command/tool execution surface changed? No
- [x] Data access scope changed? No

## Human Verification (required)

- Verified scenarios: All code paths through `resolveThinkingDefault()` — per-model override, Claude special cases, Ollama default with global config, unknown provider with global config, no global config
- Edge cases checked: Global `thinkingDefault: "off"` with provider that also defaults to "off" (result is "off" either way); global `thinkingDefault: "adaptive"` for unknown provider with reasoning model
- What you did NOT verify: Real Ollama E2E without a local Ollama instance

## Compatibility / Migration

- [x] Backward compatible? Yes — the only behavioral change is that providers with `defaultLevel: "off"` are no longer overridden by the global default, which is a bug fix
- [ ] Config/env changes? No
- [ ] Migration needed? No

## Best-fix Verdict

- **Best fix**: Yes. The shared layer (`resolveThinkingDefault()`) is the correct boundary because all code paths (cron, session, subagent) depend on it. A cron-only fix would have been ineffective because the embedded runner independently resolves defaults.
- **Refactor needed**: No
- **Alternative considered**: Removing the `resolveThinkingDefault()` call from the cron path only — rejected because the embedded runner (`src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run.ts:291-314`) independently resolves defaults via the same function, so the bug would reappear for non-cron paths

## AI Assistance 🤖

- **AI-assisted**: Yes
- **Co-Authored-By**: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
- **Human confirmed understanding of code changes**: Yes
- **AI prompts / session excerpts**: The fix was designed after reading the full call chain from `src/cron/isolated-agent/run.ts` through `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run.ts` to `src/agents/model-thinking-default.ts`, confirming that a shared-layer fix was needed rather than the cron-only approach originally suggested in the issue

## Risks and Mitigations

**Highest risk area**: Users who intentionally set `agents.defaults.thinkingDefault` and expect it to apply globally to all providers including Ollama.

**Mitigation**: These users can still enable thinking per-model via `agents.defaults.models["ollama/..."].params.thinking`, which takes highest priority. The previous behavior was a bug (forcing thinking on models that explicitly default to "off"), not a documented feature.

**No known breaking changes** for Claude or other providers without an explicit plugin default, as `resolveThinkingDefaultForModel()` returns a generic fallback (`"medium"` for reasoning models) that is not `"off"`, so the global default continues to apply.

---

Fixes #104212
